jobs.title: Sr. Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Integratie Specialist | 32–40 uur | Hybride | tot €6.100

Voor een landelijke organisatie zoek ik een Senior Integratie Specialist die niet alleen integraties bouwt, maar ook richting kan geven aan het volledige integratielandschap.

In deze rol kijk je verder dan individuele koppelingen tussen systemen. Je helpt bepalen hoe de integratielaag zich de komende jaren moet ontwikkelen, vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar schaalbare technische oplossingen en neemt een leidende rol in architectuur en technische besluitvorming.

De rol

Je werkt binnen een DevOps-team met developers, informatieanalisten, testers, functioneel beheer, een Scrum Master en Product Owner.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase waarin het integratielandschap verder wordt gemoderniseerd. Daardoor ligt de nadruk niet alleen op beheer en ontwikkeling, maar ook op architectuur, technische schuld en het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie voor de toekomst.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwikkelen en uitdragen van een visie op het integratielandschap
Vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar schaalbare en toekomstbestendige integratieoplossingen
Meedenken en beslissen over integratiearchitectuur en technische keuzes
Moderniseren van bestaande integratieketens
Verminderen van technische schuld binnen het integratieplatform
Verder ontwikkelen en verbeteren van het integratieplatform
Adviseren van technische en niet-technische stakeholders
Begeleiden en coachen van collega’s binnen het integratiedomein
Samenwerken met developers, analisten, testers, functioneel beheer en de Product Owner

Profiel

Ruime ervaring binnen integratieomgevingen
Sterke kennis van integratiearchitectuur en integratieprincipes
Ervaring met het ontwerpen van integratieoplossingen binnen complexe systeemlandschappen
In staat om verder te kijken dan individuele koppelingen en het volledige integratielandschap te overzien
Ervaring met technische en architectuurgerelateerde besluitvorming
In staat om een duidelijke technische richting te bepalen en deze binnen een organisatie uit te dragen
Sterk in het vertalen van businessbehoeften naar technische oplossingen
In staat om complexe technische onderwerpen helder uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders
Comfortabel met het nemen van eigenaarschap binnen het integratiedomein

Sterke voorkeur:

Ervaring met Azure en cloudintegraties
Ervaring met het moderniseren van bestaande integratieomgevingen
Ervaring met development naast integratiearchitectuur
Ervaring binnen complexe omgevingen met meerdere systemen en afhankelijkheden
Ervaring met het opstellen van technische standaarden en architectuurrichtlijnen

Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring met MuleSoft
Ervaring met andere integratieplatformen
Ervaring binnen een DevOps-omgeving
Ervaring met coaching, kennisdeling of technisch leiderschap

Voorwaarden

Salaris tot €6.100 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

32–40 uur per week
Hybride werken, periodiek werken vanuit regio Utrecht

Ruimte voor opleidingen en certificeringen

Dit is vooral interessant voor iemand die inmiddels verder is dan alleen het technisch realiseren van integraties en verantwoordelijkheid wil nemen voor de richting waarin een volledig integratielandschap zich ontwikkelt.

Bij interesse ontvang je aanvullende informatie over de organisatie, het team en de technische omgeving.

jobs.description:
What You’re Applying For

We're looking for an Automation-First QA Engineer to help us build quality into the Billing Platform from the ground up. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, automation, and AI — and it's core to how our Engineering team ships fast without breaking things. You'll own quality strategy for your domain and shape the tools, frameworks, and systems that let developers and AI agents move at full speed.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

Own quality strategy for the Billing Platform — setting the vision while empowering developers to lead day-to-day quality in their code
Build and evolve automated testing solutions across Web, API, and end-to-end user flows
Design tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that make quality faster, more scalable, and more autonomous
Use AI agents and prompt engineering to improve test creation, coverage analysis, and other parts of the quality lifecycle
Partner with developers, Product, and Design to surface risks early and influence technical decisions before they become costly ones
Translate quality data and delivery signals into clear recommendations on gaps, priorities, and readiness
Drive quality engineering best practices across the organization — not just within your own domain

What You'll Need

4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test
Strong coding skills in at least one modern language — TypeScript, Python, or similar
Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or comparable modern automation frameworks
Experience designing end-to-end testing strategies across Web, API, and data layers
A builder mindset — you turn ideas into tools and frameworks, not just test cases
A red team instinct — you challenge assumptions, stress-test decisions, and find the edge cases others miss
Familiarity with AI tools, prompt engineering, or AI agents, and genuine curiosity about where they take software quality next
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.description:
Technische Führung, starke Teams und verlässliche Produktentwicklung

Unser Mandant entwickelt geschäftskritische Softwarelösungen für den digitalen Handel. Die Anwendungen unterstützen mehr als 50.000 Unternehmen bei der Steuerung ihrer Warenwirtschaft sowie bei der Anbindung von Onlineshops und digitalen Marktplätzen.
Für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Softwareentwicklungsteams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die technisches Verständnis, moderne Mitarbeiterführung und einen ausgeprägten Blick für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung verbindet.
Als Engineering Manager schaffen Sie die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass aus Produktideen zuverlässige Softwarelösungen entstehen. Sie geben Ihrem Team Orientierung, fördern eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und sorgen gemeinsam mit Product Management, Tech Leads und Architektur für klare Prioritäten und realistische Ziele.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen die disziplinarische Führung eines Entwicklungsteams und begleiten Ihre Mitarbeitenden durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Coaching und individuelle Entwicklungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirken Sie an der Gewinnung und erfolgreichen Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder mit.
Gemeinsam mit dem Product Management übersetzen Sie Produktziele in umsetzbare Vorhaben und sorgen für klare Anforderungen, sinnvolle Prioritäten und eine realistische Planung.
Sie tragen Verantwortung für die verlässliche Umsetzung vereinbarter Ziele. Dabei schaffen Sie Transparenz über Fortschritte, erkennen Risiken oder Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und unterstützen das Team bei deren Lösung.
Sie gestalten die operativen Entwicklungsabläufe - von Refinements und Sprintplanungen bis zur laufenden Steuerung von Kapazitäten, Qualität und technischen Themen.
Aufgrund Ihrer eigenen Entwicklungserfahrung können Sie technische Zusammenhänge fundiert beurteilen, Lösungsansätze kritisch begleiten und sich mit Entwicklern, Tech Leads und Architekten auf Augenhöhe austauschen.
Sie fördern den Wissensaustausch und eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Teams sowie über Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg.
KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge setzen Sie reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag ein und unterstützen Ihr Team dabei, neue Möglichkeiten sinnvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery zu integrieren.

Ihr Profil

Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination eines Softwareentwicklungsteams, beispielsweise als Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Sie bringen mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in C# und dem .NET-Umfeld mit.
Sie verbinden einen wertschätzenden Führungsstil mit der Fähigkeit, klare Erwartungen zu formulieren, Entscheidungen zu treffen und auch anspruchsvolle Themen konstruktiv anzusprechen.
Sie verstehen moderne Softwareentwicklungsprozesse und haben bereits Verantwortung für Planungen, Releases oder die zuverlässige Umsetzung technischer Vorhaben übernommen.
Auch in komplexen oder über längere Zeit gewachsenen Systemlandschaften behalten Sie den Überblick und können technische sowie organisatorische Zusammenhänge einordnen.
Sie interessieren sich für die Prozesse hinter dem Produkt und möchten verstehen, wie die entwickelte Software im Arbeitsalltag der Kunden eingesetzt wird.
Im Umgang mit Veränderungen, konkurrierenden Anforderungen und begrenzten Ressourcen handeln Sie strukturiert und pragmatisch.
Sie sind offen für KI-basierte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und moderne Engineering-Ansätze.
Für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld verfügen Sie über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbungsbearbeitung

Vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse an der ausgeschriebenen Position.
Falls Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Eingang Ihrer Bewerbung keine Rückmeldung von uns erhalten, bedeutet dies leider, dass wir Ihre Bewerbung für den aktuellen Auswahlprozess nicht weiterverfolgen konnten. jobs.description:
About the role

We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.

Key responsibilities

Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack

About you

You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.

We're looking for someone who has:

A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
At least 4 years of professional software development experience
Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

High value if you also bring:

Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)

About Zendr

Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.

What we offer

Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
Work with a modern tech stack
High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth

Our hiring process

We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
Application review:
We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
First conversation:
An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
Coding assignment:
A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
Technical interview:
We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
Final meeting:
Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.

From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

Additional information

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.

As soon as possible
Scope:
Full-time, permanent position

Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

Job Description

Hej 3D Platform Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.

We’re Looking For a 3D Platform Engineer To Build The Shared Capabilities Behind IKEA’s Next Generation Of 3D Digital Planning And Product Experiences. You Will Transform Complex CAD And PLM Product Data Into Reliable, Scalable 3D Assets And Services—covering Tessellation, Mesh Optimization, LOD Generation, And Preservation Of Visual And Geometric Fidelity. Your Work Will Make High-quality 3D Product Data Easier To Use Across Customer-facing Planning Solutions, Content Production, And Product Development. On a Typical Week, You Will

Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C++, and Python.
Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well-defined development briefs.
Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
Build automated CAD-to-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
Develop and validate mesh-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
Benchmark and integrate commercial and open-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud-based 3D processing services.

Qualifications

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a 3D Platform Engineer, You Combine Strong Software Engineering With Practical Knowledge Of 3D Data, Pipelines, And Runtime Needs. You Can Work Across The Full Flow—from CAD And PLM Sources To Optimized Assets And Scalable Services. You Should Also Bring

A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business-critical services in an agile environment.
A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.

Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.

It’s a Plus If You Also Bring

Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
Experience with mesh-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

Additional Information

Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!

The ideal candidate will have a broad technical skillset and experience building and maintaining large-scale business applications. You will be involved in designing, developing and testing new features, supporting our existing applications and helping shape our technical approach.
Our technology stack includes Microsoft Azure, Java and Spring Boot, Lucee 7, Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript, Cypress and Docker. We also use services including Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory and Azure AI Foundry.

What you will do Support and develop our existing applications through bug fixes, improvements and new features
Design and develop new functionality based on client and business requirements
Help ensure product features are delivered to the required level of quality
Proactively participate in the full Scrum development lifecycle
Develop and maintain REST APIs and third-party integrations
Contribute to our Java and Spring Boot REST API
Develop and support Azure Functions and other Azure services
Work closely with QA to improve our Cypress automated test coverage
Conduct regular peer code reviews
Support and mentor other members of the development team
Identify and raise technical issues or suggested improvements
Help maintain the quality of our products throughout the development lifecycle

What you will have At least five years’ commercial software development experience
Experience with Lucee or CFML
Java and Spring Boot experience
Experience building and maintaining object-oriented web applications
Strong Microsoft SQL Server experience
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs
Good JavaScript, HTML and CSS knowledge
Experience using Git and Bitbucket
Experience working with Microsoft Azure
Experience working with Docker and containerised applications
A good understanding of secure, maintainable software development
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
The ability to work independently as part of a remote team

What you may have Experience with ColdBox, TestBox or MockBox
Cypress or other test automation experience
Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory or Azure AI Foundry
Leadership or mentoring experience
CI/CD experience
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular
Experience working within insurance, claims or document management
